Implement it in the actual application

"Implement based on this in the actual application." Then: "Take full ownership, premium colour and UI, implement."

  • Built v2 into the React app in the Midnight Navy palette: navy sidebar (Operate / Configure / Admin) with live counts, system status and account controls, plus a light header with search, clock, notifications and theme.
  • Overview: greeting and status line, compliance gauge against the target, a 7 / 14 / 30-day trend, four headline cards, live floor, "Needs attention", and by-camera, by-type and hour × weekday breakdowns, all from real data.
  • Live monitoring: All / Non-compliant / Offline filters, 1×1 / 2×2 / 3×3 layouts, tiles with stats footers and a red glow on violations.
  • Incidents: Open / Confirmed / False alarm / All tabs, a table, and a slide-over review panel with the evidence views, verdicts, J K V F keys and live updates.
  • New sign-in screen. Every other page (Reports, Cameras & zones, Settings, System health, Users, Audit) picks up the new colours, type and components. Light and dark themes.
  • Every backend call, live stream and permission is unchanged. Type check and production build pass. Every page was checked against test data at desktop and phone width with no errors.
Done

First redesign (v1, superseded)

What's running at localhost:8000 today. Screenshots use test data so every state is visible; your real cameras and incidents show in the same places.

Replaced by v2
  • ✓Top navigation: Mahindra logo, Overview · Monitoring · Incidents · Reports · Devices · Administration, with live red count badges.
  • ✓Search (Ctrl K): jump to any page, camera or incident number.
  • ✓Notifications bell for new incidents, theme switch (light / dark / system) and a user menu with change password.
  • ✓New Overview page: compliance today, open incidents, workers in view, cameras online, live tiles, "Needs attention" and 7-day breakdowns.
  • ✓Monitoring: camera list on the left, 1×1 / 2×2 / 3×3 video wall.
  • ✓Incidents: Open / Valid / False alarm / All tabs with counts, evidence and verdict panel.
  • ✓Administration: settings, system health, users and audit trail behind one side menu.
  • ✓Two-column sign-in with the Mahindra panel. Old links (#/live, #/review) still work.

Premium v2 design

Your answer to "not satisfied": a calmer, more executive interface. Now live at localhost:8000. The mockup at prototype/v2/index.html still has all three palettes.

In the app
  • ✓Sidebar navigation grouped as Operate / Configure / Admin, with plant switcher and live system status.
  • ✓Personal greeting with a one-line status ("Plant 2 is on track today").
  • ✓Compliance gauge with the 95% target marked and the reason written in plain words.
  • ✓14-day trend, incident-free streak, and an hour × weekday heatmap that shows when incidents happen.
  • ✓Live floor wall: cameras with a violation glow red, so they stand out at a glance.
  • ✓Slide-over incident review: evidence (3 views), what the model saw per PPE item, a timeline, big Confirm / False alarm buttons and the J K V F keys.

Next steps

The build is done. What remains is optional.

1

Sign in and look around You

Open http://localhost:8000 with your usual account. Your real cameras, incidents and figures fill the new screens.

2

Switch palette if you like Optional

Graphite & Champagne or Executive Petrol can replace Midnight Navy. It's a single change to the colour tokens.

3

Floor plan and shift view Needs data

The backend has no camera positions or shift times. With a plant layout and shift hours, both can be added.

4

Commit the work When you're ready

Nothing is committed yet. Your earlier uncommitted work is saved in git stash@{0}.

How to view

Paths are relative to /home/user/Documents/Mahindra/PPE_Monitoring.

Live app (v2)

Already running. Open http://localhost:8000.

# start / rebuild
docker compose up --build -d
# logs · stop
docker compose logs -f
docker compose down
